departments.label: Health and Family Welfare (Drug Deaddiction Programme)

kpis.label: Entitlement case score
kpis.desc: Average of three state percentiles: resolution rate, median days to resolve (lower is better), average age of pending cases (lower is better)

kpis.label: Gender-violence case score
kpis.desc: The same three measures, for gender-based-violence cases

kpis.label: Alternate services offered
kpis.desc: Number of different alternate (CSC) services the DAK provided in the last 12 months

kpis.label: Case reach
kpis.desc: Total DAK cases per 1,000 active SHG members (in blocks with a DAK)

kpis.label: Savings discipline
kpis.desc: Actual VRF savings ÷ savings expected if every member saved every month (member-weighted)

kpis.label: Full VRF coverage
kpis.desc: % of VOs that have received their full VRF (member-weighted)

kpis.label: VPRP coverage
kpis.desc: VOs that filed any part of the VPRP ÷ active VOs (target 100%)

kpis.label: Social issues filed
kpis.desc: VOs that filed the social issues (SDP) part ÷ active VOs (target 100%)

kpis.label: SC/ST reach
kpis.desc: SC/ST SHG members with at least one entitlement request ÷ all SC/ST SHG members (2024 plans: social category is missing in the 2025 export)

kpis.label: Plants sold per nursery
kpis.desc: Plants sold in FY 2025-26 ÷ number of nurseries (0 if the block has no nursery)

kpis.label: Payment received rate
kpis.desc: Payment received ÷ value of plants sold, FY 2025-26

kpis.label: Plantation reach
kpis.desc: Plants distributed per 100 active SHG members, 2025-26

kpis.label: Disability SHG target
kpis.desc: Disability SHGs ÷ (active VOs ÷ 2, rounded up), capped at 100%

kpis.label: Bank account
kpis.desc: Disability SHGs with an SHG bank account ÷ all disability SHGs

kpis.label: Federation rate
kpis.desc: Disability SHGs linked to a VO ÷ all disability SHGs

periods.dak: All cases registered up to 17 Sep 2026; alternate services Oct 2025–Sep 2026 (10 of 12 months scraped)
periods.vrf: VRF position of every VO, from the latest VRF data (same source as the VRF CLF tracker)
periods.vprp: Latest plan year 2025 (trend 2023–2025); SC/ST reach uses 2024
periods.nursery: Sales and payments FY 2025-26; stock as of Sep 2026
periods.nursery_excluded: 64 implausible money entries (worth Rs 5.19 crore) are left out of the money figures: a sale value with no plants sold and almost nothing paid (including Rs 3 crore for Akorhi Gola, May 2025), the same value re-entered in a later month (a running total carried forward), or more than Rs 5,000 per plant. Plants sold still count. The portal only records payment in the month of sale, so payments that arrive later never show up.
periods.disability: LokOS SHG and member profiles, scraped July 2026
periods.secondchance: Target population from LokOS member education and age; programme data awaited
